parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Enable automatic updates for operating systems and applications to protect against known security vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Automatically Patch Operating Systems and Applications

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Mandate multi-factor authentication (MFA) for administrative access, cloud accounts, remote connections, and sensitive applications.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Train employees to recognize social engineering, phishing campaigns, suspicious attachments, and credential theft techniques.

controls.title: Provide Employee Cyber Security Awareness Training

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Perform regular encrypted backups of critical business data, store backups offsite or in cloud isolation, and test recovery procedures.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Deploy and configure stateful boundary firewalls, disable unnecessary ports and protocols, and monitor ingress/egress boundaries.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Enforce device passcodes, biometric lock screens, automatic screen timeout, full-disk encryption, and mobile device management policies.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Restrict employee access rights to only those resources strictly necessary for their specific job functions.

controls.title: Establish Access Control and Least Privilege

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Ensure cloud and outsourced IT service providers meet recognized security standards and protect organizational data.

controls.title: Secure Cloud and Outsourced IT Services

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Protect public-facing websites and applications using TLS certificates, secure HTTP headers, and regular vulnerability scanning.

controls.title: Secure Website and Web Application Configurations

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Install anti-malware and endpoint detection software on all workstations and servers with automated definition updates.

controls.title: Protect Against Malicious Code and Malware

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Restrict and monitor the use of portable storage devices (USB drives) and encrypt all confidential data transferred to removable media.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Develop, document, and test an incident response plan to handle potential cyber security breaches and notify stakeholders.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Separate standard user accounts from administrative accounts; use dedicated privileged credentials only when performing administrative tasks.
